text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Suspended Istanbul police chief Kemal Yazicioglu says he was given an anonymous tip-off on the murder of casino owner in a security scandal.
- Greek Cypriot defence minister flies to Greece in a panic over today's visit to Cyprus of the head of Turkey's armed forces.
- Religious marriage is abused by religious groups.
- Residents of town of Bergama voted unanimously in a symbolic referendum against gold excavation plans due to environtmental worries.
- Interior minister gets rid of associates of former minister who resigned in security scandal.
- Trade union DISK gearing up to form a political party.
- The two coalition partners disagree over importation tax imposed on tobacco.
- Parliamentary commission investigating security scandal will question government MP who was injured in car crash that brought the affair to light
